title: Counterexamples to the Hahn-Wilson conjecture at height two
main_claim: For every sufficiently large prime p there is a connective p-complete spectrum X of exact fp-type two with X not in Thick(BP<2>_p^) for a standard form of BP<2>. The same X satisfies L_2^f X ≃ L_2 X and L_{T(2)} X ≃ L_{K(2)} X. The construction glues a cone on one complete operation a to a discrete lattice in the overlap, inside Pstragowski's algebraic model, and then transfers the result to spectra.
coverage:
Read in full: main.tex, obstruction.tex, gluing.tex, transfer.tex, the first half of consequences.tex (exact type and telescope comparisons), most of operator.tex (displacement bound, divided differences, coefficient control, initialization, rank matching, digit-stage construction), and the operations/realization statements in completion.tex.

Checked by hand:
- The finite-tower criterion (backward induction, octahedral lift, torsion-to-free vanishing, retract contradiction) and the tower normal-form lemma.
- The periodic splitting lemma.
- The microlocal flatness and principal-ideal arguments, and the right/left annihilator extraction.
- The growth lemma: Lagrange interpolation valuations, the residue factoring through H/Gamma_s, and the dimension count O(p^s)=O(n^{1/3}) from the leading monomial, using N_{p^s} >= p^{3(s-1)}.
- Dual-ghost detection: the functional pullback and the adjoint argument, the killed-subspace count cN^beta - O(N^{1/3}) - const, the b' in Sa contradiction, and the dual-homology identification.
- Index and valuation arithmetic: [H:H(i+1)] = p^{2i-floor(i/2)}, kappa <= p/(p-1), r_{2s-2} < p^s, and the closed form of the torsion valuation r_i + p/(p-1).
- Operator parameter arithmetic: qb - r'_m > X under p > 16M^2, lower-portion difference <= (p/4+2)X/p^2, separation of the first band needing p > 4M, beta = log_p(2 floor(M/8)) > 1/3 for M ~ p^{2/5}, and the B_0^{r-1} >= p^{-3 beta} N^beta count.
- Transfer: nilpotence lemma, reduction triangle, chain of thick-membership implications, finiteness of pi_i, the connective cover passing the total-finiteness fp test, exact type via Lee-Pstragowski height one plus BP<1> in Thick(b), and the telescope/K(2) comparisons.

Not independently re-derived:
- geometry.tex (the chart, gr Delta = k[sigma x,A,B,C] with the stated weights, the coinduction and relative pushforward).
- comparison.tex (applicability of Pstragowski's algebraicity, the BP-quotient cohomology).
- The fracture/topology propositions in completion.tex.
- Cited external theorems (LP2026, Lee2026, MR1999, Pstragowski2021), which I took as given.
